notes: The degree has no required algorithms or software-engineering course; slots C3 and C4 follow the brief's fallbacks (systems, capstone). Most VT CS syllabi are on Canvas; CS 3214's course site is the one public, current syllabus found. C5 (CS 4804) and C6 (CS 4264) are electives: the degree requires no AI/ML, operating systems or security course.
